correctness.rationale: The convex universal covering strip has two relevant deck-image parities: D_M²=min(a²+(Y1−Y2)²,(L−a)²+(Y1+Y2)²), while cylinder horizontal displacement is min(a,L−a). A sign reflection of Y2 conditional on a>L/2 preserves its independent symmetric uniform law and couples D_M≤D_C; strictly smaller on a positive-measure set. Folding a=|X1−X2| yields horizontal squared-gap Ξ=2L|a−L/2| uniform on [0,L²]; vertical branch difference is 4Y1Y2. Thus D_C²−D_M² has law (H²Z1Z2−Ξ)_+ with Zi uniform [−1,1]. Integrate product-positive density −log z against F(s) to obtain Δ=H⁴/(36L²) for H≤L and Δ=H²/8−L²/4+11L⁴/(72H²)+L⁴log(H/L)/(6H²) otherwise. Independently verified the exact logarithmic integral and Taylor coefficient −1/3 of h⁴/L², proving fourth derivative jump −8/L²; derivative of F(sz)/(1+2s) is positive on either branch, yielding monotonic relative defect and limiting 3/4. This holds for all L,H>0, not an extrinsic embedding metric.
